court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. V. Prabhu Government Advocate
prayer: Prayer: Writ petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of a writ of Mandamus directing the respondents particularly the 2nd respondent to consider my application dated 18.09.2019 given for an employment as Village Assistant in Thagidi Village or any other place, under the category of physically handicapped person, backward class and financially weaker person.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

N. Anand Venkatesh, J.:— The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the writ petition and he had also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. In view of the submissions and endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
